slides.say: Well, hello there, gentlemen. I am Dominique, Keeper of the Arcane Ledger. I have gazed into the scrying pool across 11 weeks of battle and 12 wizard houses. Prepare yourselves. Some of you will be flattered. Most of you will be furious.

First, the Council of Archmages. At the summit sits Give em the D-ST, wielding the strongest sorcery in the realm. Dangerbang and St. Elmo’s Fyre lurk close behind. And at the bottom of the tower? SingleBaller Semens . The stars weep for you.
Fate has favorites, and Give em the D-ST is the favorite. Their sorcery earned 6.9 wins, yet they claimed 10.0. That is 3.1 wins of pure cosmic charity.
Now, weep for cjg5022. Their magic earned 6.9 wins. The calendar paid out 5.0. That is 1.9 wins stolen by the schedule gods. Truly, a hex.

slides.big: Give em the D-ST vs Hebrew Hammers
slides.say: On to efficiency. Give em the D-ST turned every thousand points into 6.91 wins. A thrifty enchanter. Meanwhile Hebrew Hammers burned 1196.8 points for a mere 4 victories. All that mana, squandered.

Let us duel the Average Mortal, a phantom who scores the league average every week. Give em the D-ST dominates this phantom, beating it 9 times in 11. SingleBaller Semens  loses to it most weeks. And a word on SingleBaller Semens : a record of 4-7, yet only 1 wins over the Average Mortal. Smoke and mirrors.

Consider the roads you walked. SingleBaller Semens  strolled a gentle path, facing foes who scored 8.5 fewer points than a typical schedule. St. Elmo’s Fyre marched through fire. And in the kindest possible cosmos, Give em the D-ST would have gone 11 and 0.

slides.big: Give em the D-ST got away with it
slides.say: I opened 5,000 parallel universes, each with a fresh random schedule. In the typical timeline, Give em the D-ST wins 6.9 games, not the 10 they enjoyed. Enjoy it while the prophecy lasts. And cjg5022? Across the multiverse they average 6.9 wins. In this cruel timeline they got 5.

Volatility. St. Elmo’s Fyre is chaos incarnate, scoring 69.2 one week and 181.1 the next. You never know which wizard shows up. KCQueefs22 is a metronome, forever between 83.0 and 128.3. Boring, but dependable.
Finally, the omens. Give em the D-ST is running hot, scoring 18.7 points per game above their season norm over the recent weeks. Tuten has gone cold, 18.1 points below. The frost spreads.
That is the Ledger, boys. Copy the scroll, send it to the group chat, and watch the friendships burn. I am Dominique. Try not to miss me.
